claims.source_quote_ar: وهذه الآية حثٌّ من الله جل ثناؤه المؤمنين
claims.claim_ar: الآية موضوعة على نحو الحثِّ والتحريض على القتال (أسلوب الحثّ)
claims.claim_en: The verse functions as a hortatory/authoritative style — an exhortation urging believers to take up fighting.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Mobilizes and legitimizes collective action by framing the command as a divine imperative; increases urgency and obligation.

claims.claim_ar: النداء بـ«يا أيها الذين آمنوا» كتنبيهٍ مباشرٍ للمخاطَبين (التنبيه بالمخاطبة) لإثارة الانتباه والاستجابة
claims.claim_en: The vocative 'يا أيها الذين آمنوا' is a direct address that calls the addressees' attention and incites a responsive reaction.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Focuses moral responsibility on the believers, making the command personal and harder to ignore.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال فعل أمر مباشر (في الآيات المماثلة مثل «انفروا») يقابل فعل الأمر هنا «قاتِلُوا» كمظهر لأسلوب الحثِّ والتحفيز
claims.claim_en: The direct imperative form (e.g., 'انفروا' in the cited commentary) parallels the imperative 'قاتِلُوا' here, showing a hortatory/commanding rhetorical move to motivate action.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source commentary explicitly treats the imperative in a different but analogous verse (uses «انفروا»); application to «قاتِلُوا» is inferential/analogical rather than explicitly discussed in the provided chunk.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates immediacy and duty; the imperative leaves little room for optionality, pressing listeners toward action.

claims.claim_ar: خاتمة تشجيعية/طمأنة (على مثال صيغ الوعد والرأفة مثل «سيَرحمهم الله») تقوي المعنويات وتوازن حدة الأمر:
claims.claim_en: A consolatory/promise-closing that reassures the audience (analogous to formulations like 'He will have mercy on them'), reinforcing the exhortation by promising divine favor for the obedient.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source discusses analogous reassuring promises (e.g., «سَيَرْحَمُهُمُ اللَّهُ») rather than this exact phrase («اعلموا أن الله مع المتقين»); classification relies on analogy between promise-formulas.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Mitigates fear and builds confidence among the believers by promising divine support for those who obey.
